descriptions.auth_resource_list_auth: Fetch the authenticated account's own record (GET /api/auth): identity, engine and model counts, plan and credit state, and tenant info. Optional: loadRD to include engine runtime details. This is the same record the console's account page shows. Note: the POST form of /api/auth is deliberately not exposed (full-record upsert).
descriptions.clients_list__console: List clients registered through the UnityPredict console (GET /api/clients/Console): client ids, names, and registration metadata. Read-only.
descriptions.clients_list_router: List clients registered through the router (GET /api/clients/router/): client ids, names, and registration metadata. Read-only.
descriptions.repository_list_search: Browse engine-source repositories available for import (GET /api/repository/search): repository names and the engines/models they expose. Read-only.
